lessons.text: When an acceptance criterion says every or all, assert the collection with more than one element instead of a single fake instance

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a design doc specifies that one component sends a message another component reacts to verify both the sender and the receiver exist in production code not just a unit test that hand constructs the message for the receiver
lessons.text: When a design doc specifies that one component sends a message another component reacts to, verify both the sender and the receiver exist in production code, not just a unit test that hand-constructs the message for the receiver.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a mid implementation production bug is fixed e g a race between object construction and the next stream event add a regression test that reproduces the exact ordering that caused the bug not just tests that already avoid that ordering
lessons.text: When a mid-implementation production bug is fixed (e.g. a race between object construction and the next stream event), add a regression test that reproduces the exact ordering that caused the bug, not just tests that already avoid that ordering.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a test asserting a no op success on an empty degenerate input does not prove a role gate rejection assert on the actual failure rejection path the spec describes even when a structural shortcut also happens to produce the same observable outcome
lessons.text: A test asserting a no-op success on an empty/degenerate input does not prove a role-gate rejection; assert on the actual Failure/rejection path the spec describes, even when a structural shortcut also happens to produce the same observable outcome.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec ac states an exact token field count recount the referenced design doc table before writing it down a miscounted prose number creates a false discrepancy signal for the verifier even when the implementation is correct
lessons.text: When a spec AC states an exact token/field count, recount the referenced design-doc table before writing it down; a miscounted prose number creates a false discrepancy signal for the Verifier even when the implementation is correct.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a design doc gives a size weight range instead of a single value for a token the spec ac should say within the documented range explicitly or pin one exact value so the verifier isn t left guessing whether a point value chosen by the implementer is a faithful reading or a silent narrowing
lessons.text: When a design doc gives a size/weight range instead of a single value for a token, the spec AC should say 'within the documented range' explicitly, or pin one exact value, so the Verifier isn't left guessing whether a point value chosen by the implementer is a faithful reading or a silent narrowing.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a color token design doc omits a dark mode row for a token reuse the nearest semantically equivalent token s dark value not an invented hex and mark it with a spec deviation comment naming the exact row that s missing so a future design doc update can fill the gap deliberately instead of silently diverging further
lessons.text: When a color-token design doc omits a dark-mode row for a token, reuse the nearest semantically-equivalent token's dark value (not an invented hex) and mark it with a SPEC_DEVIATION comment naming the exact row that's missing, so a future design-doc update can fill the gap deliberately instead of silently diverging further.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::two independent tokens missing the same kind of dark mode row textdisabled warninginline is a signal to flag the gap in design system md itself as a follow up not just patch each call site with its own spec deviation comment
lessons.text: Two independent tokens missing the same kind of dark-mode row (textDisabled, warningInline) is a signal to flag the gap in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md itself as a follow-up, not just patch each call site with its own SPEC_DEVIATION comment.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec defines exact empty result copy only for the search query case explicitly define the origin filter only empty result copy too instead of leaving it to a silent fallback
lessons.text: When a spec defines exact empty-result copy only for the search-query case, explicitly define the origin/filter-only empty-result copy too, instead of leaving it to a silent fallback.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::give shared scaffold shell widgets a material ancestor up front so every screen s bare inkwell based children work without a per screen material wrapper workaround
lessons.text: Give shared scaffold/shell widgets a Material ancestor up front so every screen's bare InkWell-based children work without a per-screen Material wrapper workaround.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::build a component named in components md as its own shared widget file as soon as a second screen will plausibly need it not as a screen private widget to avoid future duplication
lessons.text: Build a component named in COMPONENTS.md as its own shared widget file as soon as a second screen will plausibly need it, not as a screen-private widget, to avoid future duplication.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a screen has two symmetric footer row actions wired the same way e g two buttons both calling gonamed write a navigation assertion test for each one individually not just the first identical wiring does not excuse skipping the test for its sibling
lessons.text: When a screen has two symmetric footer/row actions wired the same way (e.g. two buttons both calling goNamed), write a navigation-assertion test for each one individually, not just the first — identical wiring does not excuse skipping the test for its sibling.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec requires n identically shaped rows actions e g a 4 row preparar section test navigation for every row individually not just one representative row rendering presence checks do not substitute for a per row tap and navigate assertion
lessons.text: When a spec requires N identically-shaped rows/actions (e.g. a 4-row 'Preparar' section), test navigation for every row individually, not just one representative row — rendering/presence checks do not substitute for a per-row tap-and-navigate assertion.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a notifier exposes n status branch values e g an error state enum a confirm cancel pair write a screen level test for every one of them individually implementing a branch and testing only its sibling or the underlying state transition is not evidence the branch itself renders or navigates correctly
lessons.text: When a notifier exposes N status/branch values (e.g. an error-state enum, a confirm/cancel pair), write a screen-level test for every one of them individually — implementing a branch and testing only its sibling or the underlying state transition is not evidence the branch itself renders or navigates correctly.
